create_FlowDataset: create a FlowDataset with augmentation params and optional sparse flow support for optical flow training
create_MpiSintel_dataset: create an MpiSintel dataset for optical flow training with clean or final pass image types
create_FlyingChairs_dataset: create a FlyingChairs dataset split for training or validation optical flow data loading
create_FlyingThings3D_dataset: create a FlyingThings3D dataset with cleanpass or finalpass frames for optical flow training
fetch_dataloader: fetch a DataLoader for chairs, things, sintel, or kitti training stages with configurable augmentation
